value: Extend the public take API: negative integer counts select up to that many trailing items from a finite iterable. Preserve nonnegative counts, zero without consuming an item, None for all items, index-protocol counts. Standardize nonintegral-count rejection on TypeError (the original islice-based implementation raises ValueError). Positive counts must not consume extra items. Negative counts consume the finite iterable once with storage bounded by the requested tail. Update the existing negative-count test to the new contract; preserve all other upstream tests. Discover implementation, public consumer and test locations.
